headline: Uber (UBER) Stock Looks Cheap On Earnings While Risks Stay Pricey
summary: Uber Technologies stock has given investors a strong 70.3% return over the past 5 years, yet the current valuation checks still point to the shares looking inexpensive relative to the fundamentals. With mixed recent headlines ranging from legal challenges around Uber Eats to shifts in autonomous vehicle partnerships, the question for you is how that long term gain lines up with today's pricing. headline: Uber Eats expands U.S. grocery delivery network
summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE: UBER) has broadened its grocery delivery offerings by partnering with several regional grocery chains across the United States. The expansion adds a number of locally recognized retailers, including Busch’s Fresh Food Market, Hays, Lowe’s Market, and Piggly Wiggly, to the Uber Eats platform.

headline: Former Meta, Uber and Cloudflare CSO Joe Sullivan Joins Costanoa to Back the Next Generation of Cybersecurity Companies
summary: Costanoa, a venture capital firm investing in companies of consequence across Applied AI, AI Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, National Security, and Fintech, today announced that Joe Sullivan has joined the firm as a Venture Partner, a part-time advisory role. Sullivan will advise Costanoa's cybersecurity portfolio and help the firm source and evaluate new investments in the sector.
